title: Circulating Immune-Related Biomarkers in Egyptian Women with Early Breast Cancer: An Exploratory Case-Control Study Across IHC-Defined Clinicopathological Subgroups.
snippet: Breast cancer (BC) progression depends on immune dysregulation and complex interactions between tumor cells and host immune components. Soluble immune checkpoints, growth factors, chemokines, and cytokines are promising circulating biomarkers; however, their clinical relevance across IHC-defined clinicopathological subgroups in Egyptian BC patients remains....
